_source.name: RAPTOR SCA scan of express
_source.provenance: Scan output produced by RAPTOR's SCA pipeline against https://github.com/expressjs/express.git@4.18.2. Project source not redistributed.

advisory.summary: body-parser vulnerable to Denial of Service via trailing bytes after a compressed request body
body-parser vulnerable to denial of service when url encoding is enabled
body-parser vulnerable to denial of service when invalid limit value silently disables size enforcement
cookie accepts cookie name, path, and domain with out of bounds characters
ejs lacks certain pollution protection
hbs: Insertion of Sensitive Information into Externally-Accessible File or Directory and Exposure of Sensitive Information to an Unauthorized Actor
Inefficient Regular Expression Complexity in marked
Inefficient Regular Expression Complexity in marked
morgan vulnerable to Log Forging via unneutralized control characters in :remote-user
morgan vulnerable to Log Injection via unescaped double quote in quoted log fields
morgan vulnerable to Log Forging via unescaped Unicode line separators
multiparty vulnerable to ReDoS via filename parsing
multiparty: Denial of Service via Prototype Pollution leads to Uncaught Exception
multiparty vulnerable to Denial of Service via Uncaught Exception in filename* parameter parsing
path-to-regexp vulnerable to Regular Expression Denial of Service via multiple route parameters
path-to-regexp contains a ReDoS
proxy-addr vulnerable to IP spoofing via IPv4-mapped IPv6 trust subnet
qs: Denial of Service via Attacker Controlled isBuffer
qs : qs.stringify with arrayFormat 'comma' throws an uncaught TypeError on array elements carrying a non-callable own toString (DoS)
qs's arrayLimit bypass in its bracket notation allows DoS via memory exhaustion
qs's arrayLimit bypass in comma parsing allows denial of service
send vulnerable to template injection that can lead to XSS
serve-static vulnerable to template injection that can lead to XSS
